部署物ID。

您可以通过调用[ListArtifacts - 查询部署物列表](~~469993~~)获取部署物ID。
description.en:
The artifact ID.

Call [ListArtifacts](~~469993~~) to obtain the artifact ID.

description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of the request. The token must be unique for each request. The value of **ClientToken** can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters in length.

descriptions.zh:
### 前提条件
请确保您已创建并保存部署物。
descriptions.en:
### Prerequisites

Ensure that you have created and saved an artifact.
